spacing_authority.rule: Held target root = owner root + (24*facing,-8) in gameplay pixels; validated against all retained throw holds

policy.floor_policy: Source Blender z=0 is the art ground. Runtime collision floor is a separate measured overlay; neither actor root is moved to erase its residual.
